```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE,
                      fig.align = "center", dpi = 300)
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = here::here())

source(here::here("scripts/R/functions/report_setup.R"))
setup_report(
  sources = c("02"),
  funs = c("report_format"),
  packages = c("here", "ggplot2", "dplyr", "scales"),
  set_knitr = FALSE,
  set_theme = FALSE
)
```

```{r data, include=FALSE}
cache_file <- here("data", "tidy", paste0("psa_obj_", utility_source_label, ".rds"))
psa_obj <- if (file.exists(cache_file)) readRDS(cache_file) else NULL
scatter_all <- data.frame()
if (!is.null(psa_obj)) {
  cost_df <- as.data.frame(psa_obj$cost)
  effect_df <- if (!is.null(psa_obj$effect)) as.data.frame(psa_obj$effect) else as.data.frame(psa_obj$effectiveness)
  for (strategy in intersect(c("crp", "tmb_braf"), psa_obj$strategies)) {
    scatter_all <- rbind(scatter_all, data.frame(
      inc_effect = effect_df[[strategy]] - effect_df[["control"]],
      inc_cost = cost_df[[strategy]] - cost_df[["control"]],
      Strategy = strategy_labels[[strategy]],
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    ))
  }
}
```

```{r figure, fig.width=9, fig.height=7}
if (nrow(scatter_all) > 0) {
  p_planes <- ggplot(scatter_all, aes(x = inc_effect, y = inc_cost, color = Strategy)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.12, size = 0.35) +
    geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = WTP, linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "gray70", linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "gray70", linewidth = 0.3) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_currency(prefix = "EUR ", big.mark = ",")) +
    scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::number_format(accuracy = 0.01)) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("CRP-guided" = "#E69F00",
                                  "TMB/BRAF-guided" = "#0072B2")) +
    labs(x = "Incremental effectiveness (QALYs)",
         y = "Incremental cost (EUR)",
         color = NULL) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom", panel.grid.minor = element_blank())

  print(p_planes)
} else {
  cat("PSA cache not available.")
}
```

```{r save-figure, include=FALSE}
if (exists("p_planes")) {
  figs_dir <- here("figs")
  if (!dir.exists(figs_dir)) dir.create(figs_dir, recursive = TRUE)
  ggsave(here("figs", "figure_s3.png"), p_planes, width = 9, height = 7,
         dpi = 300, bg = "white")
}
```

Figure S3 has been saved to `figs/figure_s3.png`.
